title: temporal-leakage-audit: a temporal leakage-response instrument for clinical trial outcome prediction
description: Code and reference outputs for Auditing temporal leakage in clinical trial outcome prediction. Implements the temporal leakage-response curve and leakage-attributable performance (LAP) with cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals and its validation on synthetic data with known leakage; an as-of-time-censored drug-program benchmark built from Open Targets, ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed; audits of the CTO and TrialBench benchmarks; a nested-prompt study of memorization and knowledge leakage in language-model trial predictors, with every prompt and response; and a positivity-aware causal layer.
